# Dictionary.com

> Dictionary.com is a comprehensive English language resource providing word definitions, etymologies, games, and cultural language insights.

Dictionary.com offers authoritative definitions from multiple sources including Collins English Dictionary and Random House Unabridged Dictionary, alongside interactive word games, vocabulary learning tools, and contemporary coverage of slang, pop culture terminology, and language trends.

## Key Topics

- Word definitions
- Etymology
- Synonyms
- Slang definitions
- Internet culture
- Vocabulary learning
- Word games
- Idioms
- Acronyms
- Pop culture terms
- Language trends
- Word origins
- Example sentences
- Modern English
- Pronunciation

## Core Resources

- [Dictionary.com Homepage](https://www.dictionary.com): Main gateway to Dictionary.com: definitions, synonyms, word origins, and games.
- [Word of the Day](https://www.dictionary.com/word-of-the-day): Daily word definitions with etymology and vocabulary learning content.
- [Play Free Online Games](https://www.dictionary.com/games): Word games including WordFork, WordStrike, and 4Words for vocabulary building.

## Word Definitions & Reference

- [NAUSEOUS Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/nauseous): Definition and usage guide for 'nauseous' with examples and synonyms.
- [LOQUACIOUS Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/loquacious): Definition of 'loquacious' with etymology, examples, and related words.
- [UNDER THE WEATHER Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/under-the-weather): Definition and examples of the idiom 'under the weather.'
- [TOUCHÉ Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/touche): Definition of 'touché,' a French-origin interjection used in fencing.
- [INCOMMUNICADO Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/incommunicado): Definition of 'incommunicado' with pronunciation and Spanish etymology.
- [WYSIWYG Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/wysiwyg): Definition of WYSIWYG acronym used in word processing and publishing.
- [CHIPLET Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/chiplet): Definition of 'chiplet': small integrated circuit for semiconductor technology.
- [GLAMPSITE Definition & Meaning](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/glampsite): Definition of 'glampsite': luxury campsite with nontraditional amenities.

## Slang & Internet Culture

- [Language And Culture](https://www.dictionary.com/culture): Modern language section covering slang, emoji meanings, and pop culture terms.
- [microshifting | Slang](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/slang/microshifting): Definition of 'microshifting': flexible work scheduling practice.
- [trendjacking | Slang](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/slang/trendjacking): Definition of 'trendjacking': brands capitalizing on viral trends.
- [vibe check | Pop Culture](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/pop-culture/vibe-check): Definition of 'vibe check': checking feelings or testing coolness/attitude.
- [PSL | Acronyms](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/acronyms/psl): Definition of PSL acronym: Pumpkin Spice Latte and other meanings.
- [forever chemicals | Tech & Science](https://www.dictionary.com/culture/tech-science/forever-chemicals): Definition of 'forever chemicals': PFAS synthetic substances and toxicity.

## Featured Articles & Learning

- [Featured Articles](https://www.dictionary.com/articles): Featured articles on English language topics, word origins, and vocabulary trends.
- [Words All Book Lovers Should Add to Their Lingo Library](https://www.dictionary.com/articles/words-for-book-lovers): Guide to literary and bibliophile vocabulary for book lovers and readers.
- [Bracket Battle: Food Fight!](https://www.dictionary.com/articles/bracket-battle-2026): Interactive voting game featuring food-related words in tournament brackets.
